title: FlexRay 3.0.1 communication controller (single channel, static segment)

regs.name: CFG
regs.desc: Cluster and node configuration (static while the cluster runs)

fields.desc: clocks per sample - 1; a bit is 8 samples (0: 8 clocks per bit, 10 Mbit/s at 80 MHz)
transmission start sequence length in bits (3..15)
payload length of own frames in 2-byte words
coldstart node: runs its own schedule and is the time master
frame CRC initial value of channel B
largest accepted offset correction in clocks

regs.name: TX
regs.desc: Payload for the next own frame; writing TX3 commits it. With nothing queued the node sends a null frame

fdesc.tx_data: payload bytes, byte 0 in bits 7:0 (sent first); bytes beyond 2 x CFG.cfg_plen are not sent

regs.name: RX
regs.desc: Valid frame received in its slot (null frames included); reading RX4 frees it

fdesc.rx_data: first 16 payload bytes, byte 0 in bits 7:0

regs.name: STATUS
regs.desc: Synchronisation state and position in the cycle

fields.desc: current static slot, 0 = network idle time

irqs.name: SENT
irqs.desc: a frame carrying the queued TX payload was sent

irqs.name: ERR_SLOT
irqs.desc: frame ID or cycle count does not match the slot

irqs.name: ERR_SYNC
irqs.desc: synchronisation lost: offset correction beyond CFG.cfg_corr, or a cycle without a sync frame

notes: txd / tx_en drive the bus transceiver, rxd is its receive output.
Change CFG only while the cluster is stopped (all nodes in reset or not yet synchronised).
